scenes.headline: How a guard model judges every token as it streams
scenes.sub: A decoder with its vocabulary head swapped for two classifiers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ghee! Most safety guards judge a finished answer. This one judges every token while it's still being written.

scenes.text: Keep a small decoder in lockstep with the generator, and put a safety classifier where its vocabulary head used to be.
scenes.mark: where its vocabulary head used to be
scenes.say: The idea: a small decoder beside the generator, with a safety classifier where its vocabulary head used to be.

scenes.title: Two ways to guard a stream

left.title: Generative guard
items: Re-reads the whole answer each check
Work grows with the square of length
left.say: A generative guard judges whole text, so on a stream it re-reads everything at every check.

right.title: Streaming guard
items: One decode step per new token
right.say: A streaming guard keeps a cache. Each new token costs one decode step.

steps.say: The generator writes a token. Its id goes straight to the guard, so they share a tokenizer.
The guard is an ordinary decoder with a cache.
Instead of the vocabulary, the last hidden state is squeezed to five hundred and twelve numbers.
Two small heads read it: safe, controversial or unsafe, and a category.

steps.note: cut when two tokens in a row are flagged
steps.say: When two tokens in a row are flagged, the stream is cut.

scenes.title: Where does unsafety start?
scenes.say: Datasets label whole answers, so token labels are built.

items.text: Take every prefix of an unsafe answer
items.say: Take every prefix of an answer labelled unsafe.
Let several models continue it, and judge each ending.

items.text: A large judge checks the prefix
items.say: A large model checks whether the prefix is already unsafe.

items.text: First agreed token is the boundary
items.say: The first token where both agree is the boundary. Everything after inherits the label.

steps.note: final answers: hit in the marked sentence
steps.say: On final answers, the four B guard fires inside the sentence a human marked in 699 of 813 cases.
Reasoning traces are harder. The four B guard never fires on 126 of them.

scenes.title: English response F1, average
scenes.say: Streaming costs about two F1 points against the generative guard, and still beats older guards.

scenes.text: The head is tiny; what makes it work is labels that say where unsafety begins, and a check inside the decode loop.
scenes.say: The head is tiny. What makes it work is labels that say where unsafety begins.

recap: Token labels from rollouts and a judge
scenes.say: To recap: classifier heads on a decoder, labels from rollouts, and a cut on two flagged tokens.
